_definition: Curated list of companies in current financial distress. 'severe' = in formal insolvency/restructuring/legal-protection proceedings, payment default, or controlled by a parent in such proceedings. 'warning' = going-concern doubt disclosed in current filings and/or operating under covenant waivers. Historical, resolved episodes are NOT flagged. Informational only - does not change scores or ranks. Maintained by hand from thesis red-flag research; see docs/handoff-brief.md.

RISE:BAL1R.summary: In court-approved legal protection (restructuring) proceedings since early 2026, plan deadline extended to 5 Oct 2026; reported tax debt to the Latvian state above EUR 28m; tens of millions lent to group companies with recoverability doubts flagged by the auditor; 90% parent Amber Beverage Group defaulted on its bonds and is itself in judicial reorganisation.

ENXTPA:POMRY.summary: Operating under a court-approved conciliation protocol (Reims Commercial Court) covering the group and nine subsidiaries; net financial debt about EUR 716-754m (roughly 2.4-2.6x annual revenue); EUR 42.8m of new money from Sept 2026 carries a conciliation privilege and guarantees over vineyard assets; covenants cap shareholder payments and require minimum cash of EUR 2m; financing secured only to June 2027 (possible extension to June 2028); 2025 annual report/AGM postponed and H1 2026 net loss widened. Exclusive talks with Henkell for a majority stake ended without a deal (Aug 2026). No payment default or insolvency proceeding reported.

WSE:MSW.summary: Mostostal Warszawa reported significant 2025 losses that left equity negative and disclosed a material threat to the continuation of operations (company and group). It said it would need PLN 425-570m of extra financing from July 2026 (later revised to PLN 375-520m after contract-indexation annexes); a capital-increase resolution failed at the first shareholder meeting and an EGM was called for 29 Jul 2026 (outcome not found). Majority holder Acciona (62.13% of votes) says recapitalisation is needed and that it stays ready to take part, subject to minority support and KNF approval. No insolvency proceeding or payment default reported.
